    StartersWhoville Christmas wreathsGreen marshmallow corn flake wreaths with red candy berriesHow to make it50g butter200g marshmallows3 drops of green food colouring120g corn flakes24 small red lolliesMelt the butter and marshmallows with the green colouring.Stir through the corn flakes until coated.Shape spoonfuls into little wreaths on baking paper.Press on red lollies as berries.Set.Mount Crumpit cheesy pull-apart breadCob loaf cut and stuffed with garlic butter, mozzarella and cheddarHow to make it1 round cob loaf80g butter2 cloves of garlic, crushed1 tbsp parsley, chopped1 tbsp chives, snipped150g mozzarella, grated100g cheddar, gratedHeat the oven to 180°C. Cut the cob in a criss cross, not quite through the base.Melt the butter with the garlic, parsley and chives.Push the grated mozzarella and cheddar into the cuts and drizzle over the butter.Wrap in foil and bake.Unwrap and bake until bubbling and golden.MainsRoast beastBeef rib roast, roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and gravyHow to make it2kg beef rib roast1kg potatoes, peeled and halved3 tbsp olive oil3 eggs150g plain flour300ml milk2 tbsp vegetable oil400ml beef stocksalt and pepper, to tasteSeason the beef well, overnight if possible.Roast at 220°C, then drop to 160°C until 52°C inside.Rest the beef under foil.Roast the potatoes in oil.Whisk the eggs, flour and milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220°C.Make gravy with the stock and pan juices.Cindy Lou's Who-hash with fried eggsThe Whos' festive breakfast hashHow to make itAs written, serves 4Corned beef, potato and onion fried hard in butter until crusty, topped with runny fried eggs, pickled jalapeño and a tangy green herb sauce.Boil 800g diced potatoes for 6 minutes and drain.Fry 1 diced onion in 40g butter, add the potatoes and fry for 10 minutes, pressing down.Add 400g diced corned beef and fry until crusty, turning in sections.Blend parsley, chives, 1 garlic clove, lemon and 80ml oil for sauce.Fry 4 eggs.Serve the hash with eggs, sauce and pickled jalapeño.SweetsWho puddingFruit loaf baked in a vanilla egg custard until puffed and goldenHow to make it8 slices of fruit loaf, buttered4 eggs400ml milk200ml thickened cream60g caster sugar1 tsp vanilla extractHeat the oven to 170°C. Layer the buttered fruit loaf in a dish.Whisk the eggs, milk, cream, sugar and vanilla and pour over.Rest.Bake until puffed and golden.DrinksGrinch green punchLime sorbet, lemonade and pineapple juice in a frothy green punch, no alcoholHow to make it500ml lime sorbet1 L lemonade250ml pineapple juice2 limes, slicedScoop the sorbet into a punch bowl.Pour over the lemonade and pineapple juice so it froths up green.Add lime slices and ladle into cups.Sparkling cranberry soda spritzCindy Lou's toast at the Whobilation.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
